summary: Evaxion A/S filed a Form 6-K announcing the promotion of Birgitte Røn to the combined role of Chief Scientific Officer (CSO) and Chief Operating Officer (COO). The move follows an internal management review and is intended to align the organization for greater external engagement and strategy execution. No financial terms, stake percentages, or completion dates were disclosed. The board, via the CEO, expressed support for the expansion of responsibilities. As a non-US filer, the Form 6-K serves as the equivalent of a current report for a management change. Watch for potential further management restructuring or strategic partnerships.
